def longest_common_substr_length(s1, s2):
    """
    Finds a longest common substring length
    :param s1: First string
    :param s2: Second string
    :return: Length of longest common substring
    """

    # Initializing all values in lookup_table to zero
    lookup_table = [[0 for x in range(len(s2) + 1)] for x in range(len(s1) + 1)]

    max_length = 0
    for i in range(1, len(s1) + 1):
        for j in range(1, len(s2) + 1):
            lookup_table[i % 2][j] = 0
            if s1[i - 1] == s2[j - 1]:
                lookup_table[i % 2][j] = 1 + lookup_table[(i - 1) % 2][j - 1]
                max_length = max(max_length, lookup_table[i % 2][j])

    return max_length

                                   ["PythonRocks", "PythonIsFun"]]
  expected_outputs = [14, 4, 3, 6]
  results = []
  
  for i in range(len(inputs)):
    input = inputs[i]
    expected = expected_outputs[i]
    
    result = TestResult()
    result.input = 'longest_common_substr_length(' + str(input[0]) +', ' + str(input[1]) + ')'
    result.expected_output = str(expected)

      result.reason = "Succeeded"
